runtimeBindings.storeAndOrigins: Read actual fresh fixture state from Editor; do not transcribe credentials, bearer query or cookies into artifacts.
runtimeBindings.product: editorCatalog.products.personalization.id and live GET /v1/products/:id readback; no fixed UUID.
runtimeBindings.variants: Match exactly one actual variant by options {Cover:Moss}, {Cover:Oat}, {Cover:Slate unavailable}; validate UUID and product ownership; never index or infer from SKU/title.
runtimeBindings.reviewContexts: Fetch the actual strict no-store context separately for each actual variant at the point of review. facts_revision and review_fingerprint are echoed verbatim; never compute/mock them in preparation or client.
runtimeBindings.lineKeys: Capture actual response line IDs and hydrated data-cart-line-key; never reconstruct a product-only/variant-only identity.
runtimeBindings.checkout: Use the actual cart checkout-url response and its unchanged signed query, real session/intent IDs and UI-generated per-intent idempotency keys.
runtimeBindings.shipping: Use editorCatalog.shippingRateId and actual selected server quote. The plan expects the existing fixture COD20INR seam only after live verification.
runtimeBindings.buyer: Normal real local signup/login and returned identity. Do not reuse the API setup order or inject a session.

cartTemplateSemantics: Exact current Liquid-island request body is {lines:[...]}; POST creates without an existing cart and PATCH replaces all lines using the real returned cart token in the path. Each line properties holds only canonical selected-variant options (Cover), never personalization text or acceptance. The client merges same-config Asha into quantity2 before sending two lines. These are diagnostic expectations for existing UI requests, not a second cart client or harness. $runtime objects are non-wire binding descriptions; parse complete commands only after real runtime binding.
postPurchasePatchRules: Existing merchant save merges current metadata siblings and uses actual returned version/key/variant IDs; omit variant stock to preserve it. Reload before preparing command. Preserve other current fields. Price710 and Rain are deliberate fixture edits only; do not use for the earlier checkout.

purchaseExpected.qualification: Arithmetic assertions from the planned data, conditional on observed canonical preconditions; server responses remain money truth. COD is not a paid provider capture.

historyExpected.images: Exact images observed and saved on order creation; compare after edit, never fetch current product as history.
historyExpected.buyerDetailRoute: GET /v1/storefront/buyer/storefront-orders/:orderId with real signed site-bound session
historyExpected.buyerBffRoute: GET /api/buyer/orders?order_id=:actualOrderId through existing site-bound buyer BFF; query key is exactly order_id
historyExpected.merchantDetailRoute: GET /v1/orders/:orderId through real signed merchant and tenant permission
historyExpected.liquidView: GET /store/:actualSubdomain/account/orders/:actualOrderId renders existing customers/order through buyer-order-drop/mapOrderDetailDrop and niche_facts_text; custom local host may use its rewritten account/orders path

cases.action: Read fresh setup receipt; normal merchant/buyer login; install and locally publish actual Nova2.0.0; resolve the created product, variants, media, delivery quote and origins.
cases.expected: Fixture setup orders are excluded; store owned by signed merchant, buyer linked normally, intended installed release, baseline stock read from the canonical API. No session or UUID is injected.

cases.action: Select Moss on the real PDP and observe the no-store review request.
cases.expected: 200 strict context matches actual product/Moss IDs and revision1; no raw version, price or private supplier. Add stays blocked until explicit review.

cases.action: Request the real review endpoint without a variant for this variant product.
cases.expected: 409 VARIANT_REQUIRED; required configurator cannot fall back to generic cart properties. Record route negative separately if the UI auto-selects a variant.

cases.action: Select Slate unavailable through the existing variant control.
cases.expected: PDP marks unavailable; Add and Review cannot produce a cart mutation. If a review request is made it returns409 VARIANT_UNAVAILABLE; a suppressed request is not counted as endpoint coverage.

cases.action: Review Asha, then separately change method engrave→print, style sans→serif and placement front→back.
cases.expected: Each change removes the earlier review/acceptance, retains text, requires a new summary/review, and sends the newly chosen canonical IDs only after review.

cases.action: Review Moss/Asha, select Oat, then return to Moss.
cases.expected: Old reviewed context is invalidated on every UUID change; actual current-variant no-store context and renewed explicit review are required before Add.

cases.action: Review valid Hindi आशा with unicode-letters.
cases.expected: Accepted exact NFC text equals आशा; method/style/placement labels are server-fact labels. This is a review case with no purchase claimed.

cases.action: Type decomposed Jose\u0301, attempt review, explicitly choose Use suggested text, then review José.
cases.expected: Before consent input stays decomposed, NORMALIZE_TEXT appears and Add stays blocked; suggestion is José. The separate affirmative action and review yield exact composed José. No silent normalization.

cases.action: After a valid preview, type <Asha>, nineteen A letters, then Asha🙂.
cases.expected: Canonical errors appear, exact invalid input stays editable, last valid illustrative preview is identified, and neither cart nor checkout is called.

cases.action: Review/add Asha1 and separately review/add Kabir1 on the same Moss UUID.
cases.expected: Two server line identities, same product/variant, accepted texts Asha/Kabir, distinct configuration and snapshot hashes. Every request carries strict personalization; properties contains only {Cover:Moss}, never draft text, method, review echo or accepted status.

cases.action: Review/add Asha1 again with identical method/style/placement/variant.
cases.expected: One Asha line quantity2 and one Kabir line quantity1; no third configuration or extra inventory SKU.

cases.action: Increase only Asha2→3 with the full cart control.
cases.expected: Only captured Asha line key changes; Kabir stays1. Aggregate Moss quantity4 matches verified baseline availability4; review/configuration identity does not change for quantity alone.

cases.action: Try increasing Asha3→4 while Kabir remains1.
cases.expected: Aggregate5 exceeds verified Moss availability4:409 INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY. Canonical cart remains Asha3/Kabir1. UI must recover to accepted state or show explicit unsaved failure; optimistic quantity is not server acceptance.

cases.action: Remove only Kabir, reload the full cart, re-add reviewed Kabir1, then reduce Asha3→1.
cases.expected: Removal selects captured line key; Asha3 survives exact. Reload keeps that identity/text. Final purchase cart is exactly Asha1/Kabir1; canonical server response supplies money.

cases.action: Inspect the actual cart and public PDP responses and DOM.
cases.expected: No private supplier marker or catalog_source; no order history, cart bearer token, reviewed buyer text or backend provenance is published through anonymous catalog/Liquid data.

cases.action: Proceed through the installed cart checkout link, normal signed buyer identity, contact, actual COD delivery quote, COD intent and confirm UI.
cases.expected: One new local COD order containing exactly Asha1/Kabir1. Every existing handoff query/signature is preserved; server cart references and totals are used. Record actual order ID and count delta; setup/API prerequisite orders are not counted.

cases.action: Retry the same confirm intent/return and reload the confirmation.
cases.expected: Same order ID and captured immutable line facts; one inventory effect, one new purchase order and no duplicate effect. Keep keys/tokens only in existing private runtime state.

cases.action: Before editing catalog, open own buyer order UI/Liquid order view and authorized merchant order detail.
cases.expected: All authorized views show Asha and Kabir separately, original method/style/placement and Cover=Moss. The strict saved niche_snapshot contains revision1; no extra visible revision label is assumed.

cases.action: After purchase, open a fresh Oat review for Asha without adding; hold the reviewed draft. Merchant saves the documented revision2 catalog patch; attempt the held Add.
cases.expected: 409 PERSONALIZATION_STALE; no new cart line/order/inventory effect. Failed Asha draft stays, current context refreshes and old review is invalid. Re-review against revision2 and retry once; canonical accepted cart has one Oat/Asha line.

cases.action: After the revision2 product/name/price/option change, reload the same purchased order on buyer, merchant and Liquid paths.
cases.expected: Old saved snapshot and images are unchanged: Asha/Kabir, revision1, Front engraving/Sans/Front and Cover=Moss. New PDP shows revised product facts/options. No current catalog fallback in historical readback.

cases.action: Using an unsubmitted reviewed draft, merchant explicitly removes personalization facts through existing product edit; retry current review/Add on the already required configurator.
cases.expected: Review409 PERSONALIZATION_UNAVAILABLE; no generic-properties fallback or new order. Earlier purchased history remains intact. Record any already accepted cart unchanged; do not silently delete or rewrite it.

cases.action: During a current review-context load only, record a deliberate browser network refusal, restore network, and activate existing Try personalization again.
cases.expected: Unavailable/retry state retains text and disables purchase. Restored real no-store response and renewed review permit Add. Never synthesize a successful context, fingerprint or token.

cases.action: Sign out, then use a second normally registered buyer to request the first buyer order; check a genuinely unrelated merchant identity if allocated.
cases.expected: Anonymous401; other buyer404 after verified ownership lookup. Merchant must receive the route actual denial under tenant/permission checks. No historical text, selected options or private metadata is exposed.

validationPolicy: Only canonical static field/domain validation is authorized now. Full UUID/token/context/command validation and every browser/DB case remain NOT_RUN until explicit shared-fixture allocation.
sequenceRules: Execute context/review cases before mutating carts. No review-only case is a purchase.

Before the exact shared-stock4/5 cases, observe canonical Moss available4 and reserved0 from the untouched synthetic fixture. If not true, report the failed precondition and coordinate; do not reset inventory or invent an availability count.
Complete the single Asha1/Kabir1 purchase before the revision2 product edit. Preserve actual old order ID and strict snapshots before editing.
Use a new cart and an unsubmitted Oat draft for the stale-review race after purchase. Never reuse a converted cart token or silently rewrite earlier accepted fulfillment instructions.
Run transport recovery MY-21 while revision2 capabilities still exist, before deliberate removal MY-20. Missing facts cannot be repaired by restoring the network.

Use existing exact-line remove/add controls for intentional configuration replacement; the current cart has no invented inline personalization editor. If retained lines become stale, keep them until an explicit removal/re-review succeeds and record any usability gap.
Compare purchased-order count and stock deltas within this product/cart/confirm intent, excluding baseline setup order IDs and unrelated shared-fixture purchases.
Every field with $runtime is a binding description rather than JSON to send. No command is dispatched by these docs or the static validator.
